message:
CREATE TABLE message (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_id VARCHAR, 
	content_md VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	parent_message_id VARCHAR, 
	stream_state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_message_id) REFERENCES message (id)
)
session:
CREATE TABLE session (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	session_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	bound_branch VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	worktree_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	last_message_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace (id)
)

taskrun:
CREATE TABLE taskrun (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	agent_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	adapter_run_id VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	worktree_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	base_ref VARCHAR, 
	head_ref VARCHAR, 
	error_code VARCHAR, 
	error_message VARCHAR, 
	metrics_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES task (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agent_id) REFERENCES agent (id)
)
agentprofiledraft:
CREATE TABLE agentprofiledraft (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	avatar_initials VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	adapter_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	provider_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	capability_tags_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	supported_targets_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	supported_modes_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	safe_for_write BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	safe_for_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace (id)
)
taskrunevent:
